sloka: त्र्यहोऽश्व मेधः संख्यातः कल्प सूत्रेण ब्राह्मणैः ।चतुष्टोमम् अहः तस्य प्रथमम् परिकल्पितम् ॥१-१४-४०॥
transliteration: tryaho'śva medhaḥ saṁkhyātaḥ kalpa sūtreṇa brāhmaṇaiḥ ।catuṣṭomam ahaḥ tasya prathamam parikalpitam ॥1-14-40॥

translations.english: Jyotishtoma and Ayuryaga in Atiratra, Abhijit, Viswajit and Aptoryama ceremonies constituting the great sacrifice were performed in the prescribed manner.
